tests.description: Both characters can be selected and sent to a clicked ground position, moving independently.
tests.name: Select characters and move
source: harness.assert(!!move,`${name} receives a Move order on floor right-click`);
harness.assert(Number.isFinite(tx)&&Number.isFinite(ty),`${name}'s move order has a ground destination`);
harness.assert(moved,`${name} visibly moves after the order`);
harness.assert(Math.hypot(after.x-tx,after.y-ty)<Math.hypot(before.x-tx,before.y-ty),`${name} moves closer to the clicked location`);

tests.description: Both characters can be selected, sent to the fridge, and complete its hunger-restoring task.
tests.name: Complete task object interactions
source: harness.assert(!!task && targetId===harness.getObjectVariable(fridge.id,'ObjectID')?.value,`${name} receives the clicked fridge task`);
harness.assert(completed,`${name} completes the fridge task and restores hunger`);
harness.assert((harness.getObjectVariable(character.id,'Tasks.List')?.children?.length||0)===0,`${name}'s completed task is removed from the queue`);
